rows.notes: The study is a narrative review (labelled 'Review' in the journal header; abstract says 'we reviewed the application of different types of UAVs'). Table 1 compiles R2 values from other authors' studies; no own data, experiment or model runs are reported. Fig. 1 shows the authors' own UAV and vineyard images but no results. Hence Q1 is 'no'. The review discusses UAV indices correlating with water potential and stomatal conductance (cited work), but reports no own result on improved irrigation efficiency or reduced pumping costs.
